name: MariaDB
description: The MariaDB app is a unified logs and metrics app that helps you monitor the availability, performance and resource utilization of MariaDB database clusters. Preconfigured dashboards and searches provide insight into the health of your database clusters, performance metrics, resource metrics, schema metrics, replication, error logs, slow queries, Innodb operations, failed logins and error logs.

children.name: Logs
children.description: This folder contains log based dashboards for MariaDB

children.name: MariaDB - Error Logs
children.description: The MariaDB - Error Logs dashboard provides insight into database error logs by specifically monitoring database shutdown/start events, errors over time, errors, warnings and crash recovery attempts.
children.title: MariaDB - Error Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} (Error or Warning or Note or Info or Information or DEBUG or CRITICAL)
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)" nodrop
| where touppercase(ErrorLogtype) in ("ERROR", "WARNING", "NOTE", "INFO", "INFORMATION", "DEBUG", "CRITICAL")
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, ErrorLogtype
| transpose row _timeslice column ErrorLogType

_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "[ERROR]"
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)"
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| ErrorMsg as error_message
| count as frequency by error_message, db_cluster, host
| sort by frequency, error_message asc
| fields db_cluster,host,error_message,frequency
| limit 30

_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "[Warning]"
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)"
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| ErrorMsg as warning_message
| count as frequency by warning_message, db_cluster, host
| sort by frequency, warning_message asc
| fields db_cluster,host,warning_message,frequency
| limit 30

panels.title: Server Start and Shutdown Events Over Time

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} ("ready for connections" or "Shutdown complete" or "Terminated." or "Normal shutdown" or "Shutting down" or "starting as process")
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)" nodrop
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*ready for connections*", "Up","Unknown") as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*Terminated.*", "Down", server_status) as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*Normal shutdown*", "Shutting Down", server_status) as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*Shutting down*", "Shutting Down", server_status) as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*Shutdown complete*", "Down", server_status) as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*starting as process*", "Starting",server_status) as server_status
| timeslice 15m
| count by _timeslice, server_status
| transpose row _timeslice column server_status

_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "Crash recovery"
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)" nodrop
| _sourceHost as Host
| timeslice 1h
| count as recovery_attempts by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} ("ready for connections."  or "Terminated." or "Shutdown complete" or "Normal shutdown")
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)" nodrop
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*ready for connections.*", "Up","Unknown") as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*Terminated.*", "Down", server_status) as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*Normal shutdown*", "Shutting Down", server_status) as server_status
| if (ErrorMsg matches "*Shutdown complete*", "Down", server_status) as server_status
| _sourceHost as Host
| timeslice 100s
| withtime server_status | withtime _messagetime
| most_recent(server_status_withtime) as server_status, most_recent(_messagetime_withtime) as m_time by Host, db_cluster
| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS Z") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as remark
| where server_status != "Up"
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields Host, event_time, server_status, remark, db_cluster

_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} ("ERROR" or "CRITICAL") 
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| logreduce(mesg) by db_cluster limit=20
| _count as count | fields -_count | sort by count, signature asc

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} "[Note]" "SQL thread"
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)" nodrop
| parse field=ErrorMsg "Slave SQL thread initialized, * replication in log '*' at position *, relay log '*' position: *" as State,ReplicationLog,ReplicationPosition,ReplayLog,RelayPosition nodrop
| parse field=ErrorMsg "Slave SQL thread exiting, replication * in log '*' at position *" as state,ReplicationLog,RelayPosition nodrop
| where state in ("starting", "stopped")
| timeslice 1h
| count as event_count by _timeslice, state
| transpose row _timeslice column state as starting, stopped
| (starting+stopped)/2 as halfway_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} (("[ERROR]" and ("Slave I/O" or "Error reading packet from server" or "Slave SQL")) or ("[Note] Error reading relay log event: slave SQL thread was killed"))
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)" nodrop
| ErrorMsg as error_message
| count as frequency by error_message, db_cluster
| sort by frequency | limit 10

_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster={{db_cluster}} ("[Note]" or ("[ERROR]" ("Slave I/O" or "Error reading packet from server" or "Slave SQL")))
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "\[(?<ErrorLogtype>[^\]]*)][\:]*\s(?<ErrorMsg>.*)" nodrop
| parse field=ErrorMsg "Slave SQL thread initialized, * replication in log '*' at position *, relay log '*' position: *" as State,ReplicationLog,ReplicationPosition,ReplayLog,RelayPosition nodrop
| parse field=ErrorMsg "Slave SQL thread * because it reached its UNTIL position *" as State, StoppedUntilPosition nodrop
| parse field=ErrorMsg "Error reading relay log event: slave SQL thread was *" as state nodrop
| if(_raw matches "*[ERROR] Slave I/O*" or _raw matches "*[ERROR] Error reading packet from server*"  or _raw matches "*[ERROR] Slave SQL*","failed",state) as state
| where state in ("starting", "stopped", "killed", "failed")
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, state
| transpose row _timeslice column state
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

External lock can be for: read external, write external
